column1: When off: every process of this app, including your Kyanite systems, cannot reach the network (a local VPN with no exit silently drops their traffic; Android asks for VPN consent once). The VM gets no network device. The app itself will not download rootfs, check for updates, or open the browser.
column2: 关闭时：此应用的所有进程（包括你的 Kyanite 系统）都无法访问网络（没有出口的本地 VPN 会悄悄丢弃它们的流量；Android 会请求一次 VPN 授权）。虚拟机不会获得网络设备。应用本身也不会下载 rootfs、检查更新或打开浏览器。

column1: While a system is not in use it is stored as an archive: compressed (saves space with many systems) and/or encrypted with AES-256-GCM. It is unpacked when you start it and packed again when the session ends. Protects stopped systems against malware or backdoors in a running one, and against someone copying your files.
column2: 系统不使用时会以归档文件形式存放：可压缩（系统很多时能节省空间）和/或使用 AES-256-GCM 加密。启动时解包，会话结束时重新打包。这样能保护已停止的系统不受运行中系统里的恶意软件或后门影响，也能防止别人复制你的文件。
